$comment: ADR-008 path-grammar fixture corpus — single source of truth for TS (vitest) and Rust (include_str!) parity tests. Stage 1 of the addressing track. Sections: tokenize (parsePathSegments), canonicalize (section canonicalizer siblings), match (matcher module, both modes), roundtrip (property specs run by stages 2a+2b against a seeded tree). No PII: all names synthetic per test-fixtures-no-pii.md.

tokenize.name: alias_split_happens_first
tokenize.$comment: parseWikilinkInner strips alias; parsePathSegments sees only the target

tokenize.name: marker_in_segment_is_fine
tokenize.$comment: only [[ ]] depth is guarded; single brackets are content

tokenize.name: empty_middle_segment_is_opaque
tokenize.$comment: parse error → whole target treated as one opaque name (old behavior preserved)

tokenize.name: bare_gt_does_not_split
tokenize.$comment: DECIDED (ADR-008 amendment 7c7fcc58): separator is whitespace-delimited '>' — at least one whitespace char each side. Bare '>' protects generics/arrows in targets.

tokenize.name: tab_delimited_gt_splits
tokenize.$comment: any whitespace char qualifies, not just space

tokenize.name: nbsp_delimited_gt_splits
tokenize.$comment: Unicode White_Space, not ASCII/JS-\s — NBSP (macOS Opt+Space) must split identically in both twins; \p{White_Space} ≡ char::is_whitespace (CodeRabbit PR #359)

tokenize.name: unbalanced_nesting_is_opaque
tokenize.$comment: unbalanced [[ → treat whole target as opaque

canonicalize.name: hash_number_is_not_heading
canonicalize.$comment: parity with page_title_from_content: # without space is content

canonicalize.name: bold_markers_survive_canonicalize
canonicalize.$comment: canonicalizer = title extraction + lowercase + trim ONLY; markdown stripping is fuzzy rung 2 (matcher), NOT the canonicalizer — keeps rung 1 (exact/write predicate) strict

match.$comment: Tree seeds use content strings + createdAt (epoch ms). candidates = children of one parent. Expected = index into candidates, or null (no match). mode: exact = write predicate ≡ fuzzy rung 1.

cases.name: exact_does_not_fuzzy
cases.$comment: prefix/contains must NOT match in exact mode — a fuzzy write is a bug (ADR-008 D2)

cases.name: missing_createdAt_never_steals
cases.$comment: createdAt 0/missing compares as +infinity, matching PageNameIndex add_existing_page semantics

cases.name: fuzzy_rung1_exact_first
cases.$comment: exact rung beats contains rung regardless of recency

cases.name: fuzzy_rung4_marker_match
cases.$comment: rung 3 (contains) runs against marker-STRIPPED content so a segment that only appears inside a [key::value] marker falls through to rung 4 (marker-value match) — otherwise rung 4 is dead code (the value is always a literal substring of the raw content)

cases.name: empty_canonical_segment_no_exact_match
cases.$comment: segment canonicalizes to empty — matches nothing (guarded entry points, CodeRabbit PR #359)

cases.name: empty_canonical_segment_no_fuzzy_match
cases.$comment: empty key would make rung-3 includes('') match every candidate — guarded

roundtrip.$comment: Property specs — not unit fixtures. Stage 2a (read) and 2b (write) PRs both execute these against a hermetic scratch server. Written here so both PRs share one definition.

properties.name: write_then_read
properties.spec: POST path P with content X where no segment of P exists → all intermediates created as direct-child chain → GET /resolve?path=P&mode=exact returns the leaf; mode=fuzzy returns the same leaf

properties.name: write_is_idempotent
properties.spec: POST path P twice → second POST creates zero new blocks; leaf receives second content as new child (or per ADR write semantics); block count delta between POSTs = payload blocks only

properties.name: read_skips_levels_write_does_not
properties.spec: seed page > A > B > C; GET /resolve path 'page > C' (fuzzy) finds C via descendant skip; POST path 'page > C' (exact, direct-child) does NOT match the nested C — creates a new direct child C under page

properties.name: miss_lands_deepest
properties.spec: seed page > A; resolve 'page > A > missing' (fuzzy) → deepest-resolved = A, notice carries unresolved tail ['missing']; no block created
